blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `updateProductOptionValuesOnProductStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.
This step updates product option values linked to products.

children.name: add
children.description:
The IDs of specific option values to add to the product option, or value
objects to create and link.

children.name: remove
children.description: The IDs of specific option values to remove from the product option.
